verdict.rationale: Asking whether a notes app has a built-in AI assistant is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no AI assistant inside Anytype itself. What it does show is an MCP server, an agents skill and a local API that let external assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) read and modify your notes. Those are developer building blocks and user-side external tools, not a built-in assistant grounded in your notes with data-visibility controls, so they earn no credit.
